title: Wildfire smoke now bigger prenatal threat than human sources of air pollution
summary: Wildfire smoke exposures are likely to have vast public health consequences, Jaspers said. But data sources like Purple Air that track wildfire smoke are detecting a large amount of pollution in the form of a PM2.5 inside people’s homes, he said.
